items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: But Gordon had a way of playing a shuffle and things like that man that to this day when I play the show we play a tune and I just cop that off of Gordon.

ctx.x: Gordon Smith, yeah. He was about — he passed away young like 27 or something.
